basic_profile.bio: I'm a 29-year-old living in Southern California. I'm a huge fan of martial arts and 80s nostalgia, which naturally led me to love Cobra Kai. I work as a freelance graphic designer, which gives me flexible hours to indulge in my hobbies like collecting Victorinox knives and customizing RGB lighting setups for my PC. I'm single and enjoy spending my evenings binge-watching shows or exploring new subreddits. I'm usually online late at night, after 10 PM.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a background in graphic design, mostly self-taught through online resources and tutorials. My interest in technology and design led me to explore RGB setups and customizations, which is a side hobby of mine. I also have a decent knowledge of pop culture from the 80s and 90s, thanks to growing up with parents who were big fans.
